about: Hand corrections to the catalog's structured major requirements. The catalog sometimes states a rule only in a note ("ECON 191AA-ZZ", "These courses will NOT apply to the major"), which the structured data can't express. Each correction names the rule it changes by the rule's catalog id, says why, and quotes the catalog note it comes from. build_majors.py warns if a rule id no longer exists.

pngKx5Ir.why: Area D's note says "ECON 191AA-ZZ": any lettered ECON 191 topic counts. These are the two in the current catalog.

qzJtgDwL.why: The electives note says "ECE 194AA-ZZ (except 194R)". These are the lettered ECE 194 courses in the current catalog; none is 194R.

vHXuFXlL.label: Capstone
vHXuFXlL.why: The catalog lists both capstone sequences as required, but students take one. The department's requirement sheet lists them as one requirement, "CMPSC 189A-B / ECE 189A-B-C" (8-12 units), and its 4-year plan puts "ECE 189A / CMPSC 189A" in the same slot. The rule's own note gives a different prerequisite for each sequence. Source: https://www.ce.ucsb.edu/sites/default/files/2023-08/gear-23-24-ce-major-require-4-yr-plan-pgs-16-17.pdf
